name: What is the installation process for noise-reducing sliding doors?

mainEntity.name: What is the installation process for noise-reducing sliding doors?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation process typically begins with the removal of your existing sliding door and frame. We then prepare the opening, ensuring it is level, plumb, and properly sealed to prevent air and sound leaks. The new noise-reducing door frame is carefully installed and secured, followed by the insertion of the door panels. Finally, we apply weatherstripping, adjust the rollers for smooth operation, and complete any necessary interior and exterior trim work, ensuring a tight, sound-blocking seal.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves removing the old door, preparing the opening, installing the new frame and door panels, sealing, and finishing trim work for a sound-blocking fit.
